evals.prompt: Turn https://example.com/a-long-essay into a private listening reader on localhost and Tailscale. Use the newest strong local voice, preload the complete narration, and highlight each word as it is spoken.
evals.expected_output: A verified reader site generated from Defuddle Markdown with local Qwen narration, synchronized timings, and working local and tailnet URLs.
expectations: The URL is fetched through Defuddle and extraction debris is inspected.
The output includes a full cached audio track and one timing record per rendered word.
Existing Tailscale Serve routes are preserved.

evals.prompt:
Lazyread this pasted Markdown plan. Keep the headings and checklist formatting, make it work beautifully on my iPhone, and keep everything local: # Launch plan

## Before launch
- [ ] Verify backups
- [ ] Brief support

## Launch
Ship at 10:00 and monitor errors for an hour.
evals.expected_output: A mobile reader preserving the supplied Markdown structure, with local natural narration and liquid-glass playback controls.
expectations: Pasted Markdown is preserved rather than summarized.
Missing frontmatter is added and the H1 becomes the title.
Mobile QA confirms no overflow and touch targets of at least 40px.

evals.prompt: Make an audio read-along site from my notes.md file. Localhost only this time. I need click-to-seek, 1.5x playback, exact highlighting, and I don't want playback to pause for network buffering.
evals.expected_output: A localhost-only read-along site generated from the supplied file and verified for exact synchronization and complete preloading.
expectations: No Tailscale route is created because it was not requested.
Play is unavailable until the full track is cached and decodable.
Click-to-seek, speed changes, pauses, and highlighting are browser-tested.
